findings.details: The chapter said the AOSP APV software decoder prefers requested output and falls back from P210 to P010/RGBA1010102/YV12, but android-17.0.0_r1 C2SoftApvDec.cpp keeps the default HAL_PIXEL_FORMAT_YCBCR_420_888 buffer path at YV12 and only enters the P210/P010/RGBA1010102 fallback ladder for non-420_888 requested formats such as implementation-defined Surface output.
findings.summary: APV soft decoder output fallback omitted default YV12 buffer path
